correctness.rationale: Verified signed matrix-tree cofactor equals the unnormalized Walsh coefficient, including negative edge signs. Symmetric/antisymmetric rail diagonalization gives W_a=(product a_j)/2 det(H_n(a)-2I). The standard path Laplacian eigenvalues yield W_rung=-sin(pi n/2). The ladder recurrence tau_n=4tau_(n-1)-tau_(n-2), tau_1=1,tau_2=4 gives tau_n odd iff n odd, hence every signed tree sum odd and nonzero. For even n, the length-four periodic u=(1,-1,-1,1,...) has H_n(a)u=2u for arbitrary signs on even-numbered links, producing 2^{m-1} distinct zeros. Independent exhaustive tree enumeration and integer Walsh transform for n=1..5 gives tau=1,4,15,56,209, zeros=0,6,0,200,0, and odd min=1. Finite checks corroborate but infinite proof comes from determinant/parity.
